sloka: न ह्यकार्यतमम् किम्चित् तव देवीह विद्यते ।पतिघ्नीम् त्वामहम् मन्ये कुलघ्नीमपि चान्ततः ॥२-३५-६॥
transliteration: na hyakāryatamam kimcit tava devīha vidyate ।patighnīm tvāmaham manye kulaghnīmapi cāntataḥ ॥2-35-6॥

translations.english: King Dasaratha is invincible like Indra, unshakeable like a mountain and unperturbable like the ocean. By causing grief to him through your action I feel you are killing your husband (inch by inch). I think you are ultimately destroying your own race.
